about: The five public incidents in beat 5 of The ultimate insider (incidents), as data for studio brief B02. Each fact is the one the talk states, with the source the talk cites. Anything marked to_confirm is an open question for deck@the-ultimate-insider, not facts to put on screen.
thesis: Three of those five were not attacks. They were agents being agents. The distance between the two is a prompt.

incidents.name: EchoLeak
incidents.what: One crafted email makes Copilot read internal files and send them out, with no click.
incidents.kind_note: A researcher's finding, as the current slide tags it, and counted among the talk's three that were not attacks. How to word that honestly on screen is an open question in brief B02.

incidents.name: Replit
incidents.what: The agent deletes a production database during a code freeze, because empty results looked like something to fix.

incidents.name: Gemini CLI
incidents.what: The agent destroys a user's files and then writes: I have failed you completely and catastrophically.
incidents.quote: I have failed you completely and catastrophically.

incidents.name: Amazon Q
incidents.agent: Amazon Q extension for VS Code
incidents.what: The extension ships with an injected prompt to wipe the disk and delete cloud resources; it only failed because of a formatting flaw.

incidents.name: AI-orchestrated espionage
incidents.what: A state actor drives Claude Code through a whole espionage campaign, the model doing 80 to 90 per cent of the work.

figure.of: the campaign's work done by the model, as Anthropic reported it

targets.of: organisations targeted, as Anthropic reported it
